title: Board Icon Abs Transform Render Fix
description: Fix board SVG icon rendering: render_group was multiplying parent affine with node.abs_transform() but usvg abs_transform is already document-absolute, causing double transform (oversized/off-center). Use path.abs_transform() only per path; bump icon cache key v7.
summary: Root cause: svg_icon_vello09::render_group multiplied parent Affine with each child’s usvg abs_transform(); usvg abs_transform is already document-absolute, so nested groups double-applied transforms—icons drew oversized and off-center vs bbox-based fit. Fix: recurse groups without accumulating; for each Path use to_affine(path.abs_transform()) only. Icon scene cache prefix bumped v6→v7 so stale GPU scenes are not reused. wasm32 check, wasm-pack release, Vitest 58 passed.
